question: Do the paired feature-mask effects observed at seed 7 persist under two additional training seeds, at fixed data and client assignments?
seed_rule: Replace the model/training seed with 17 or 27; keep partition_seed=7. Pair every mask within a lane/seed. Do not pool different client partitions as training-seed replication.

partitions.rule: Reuse frozen assignments and exact row order across arms and model seeds, not a fresh Dirichlet sample. Full participation and one full local epoch; persistent central Adam versus freshly initialized local Adam each client-round, unchanged from the reference.

secondary_endpoint: Validation-best and original all-validation scores are descriptive only; never replace final shared-panel values.

analysis.seed_roles: Seed 7 is the exploratory reference motivating this stage. Report seeds 17 and 27 as prospective confirmations, both separately and in the descriptive three-seed summary.
analysis.unit: One paired training seed, not individual validation rows or epochs
analysis.comparisons: Within each lane and seed, each masked arm minus full39. Retain all 27 endpoints.
report: paired macro-F1 and benign false-alert differences
all eight class precision, recall and F1 differences
analysis.aggregation: Mean, sample SD, range and raw paired values. Three seeds are descriptive replication, not a reliable significance/equivalence test.
analysis.no_automatic_promotion: Do not select the best seed, best round or mask from aggregate F1 alone; retain false-alert and rare-class trade-offs.
limits: Fixed partitions do not measure partition-draw uncertainty
Reused within-collection validation is not a fresh holdout or unseen-session evidence
Joint masking removes legitimate size information too

execution.order: seed17, then seed27; within each seed light, iid, dirichlet; within each lane full39, number_masked, number_total_masked
execution.stage_boundary: Check integrity after seed17, not whether scores look favorable. Complete seed27 unchanged unless an integrity/runtime problem requires review.
execution.preflight: Hash-bound seed7 archive, unchanged complete training-source inventory, runtime, pack, panel and exact client assignments; no training in check mode
execution.recovery: Explicit --resume only. Verify completed artifacts before skipping them. Resume incomplete runs only from a saved completed-step checkpoint with unchanged session/plan/wrapper/source/settings. Never silently overwrite or restart partial runs.
execution.scope: No larger data, hyperparameter tuning, architecture changes, test evaluation or cloud automation.
